title: App classes come from local CSS Modules
intent: Apply classes to native elements through a direct property naming a class defined in a sibling CSS Module. Configure framework controls through their component props. Inline style, arbitrary class names and hardcoded color literals in app script are refused.
reference: Use theme tokens for component colors, typography and spacing. Use a plain Page for a custom screen.

runtime.rationale: style/className are authoring-surface attributes: the token pipeline itself emits inline styles and class names into the built DOM, so their presence at runtime is legitimate and unattributable to app authorship.
